purpose: Independent base-training natural-error readout pilot; no validation examples used as fitting/tuning data.

annotation_facts.manual_anchor_rule: C-TAO is_ori=true AND unique (video_id, original frame_index, track_id) in official TAO train AND unique old-synset-to-v1 category mapping equals C-TAO category AND bbox equal within 1e-6. Other C-TAO boxes excluded from supervised targets.

dedup.source_group_rule: YouTube/movie for AVA; YouTube/youtube_id for HACS; ArgoVerse/sequence across cameras; dataset/full clip name otherwise.
dedup.limitations: Metadata dedup only. No image content dedup, Charades-subject holdout or YFCC-uploader holdout was performed.

vocabulary.category_holdout_meaning: Pseudo-novel only to this readout learner. Base detector/CLIP may have seen these classes; this is not detector-unseen-category evidence.
required_before_collection: Export explicit posterior_category_ids and actual fusion mask in each run manifest/dump; check each branch column count and mapping.
Generalize cache builder away from val296 mapping and entropy denominator log296.
CPU schema or isolated smoke must prove returned det_labels+1 mapping and complete 1203+background support; no smoke was run here.

name_alias.mapping_rule: Preserve numeric category IDs and record this typo alias; do not reorder by display name.

full_metadata_split.unit: source group; video trajectories remain nested repeated observations
full_metadata_split.allocation: Within each source dataset, SHA256-ranked source groups: floor(80%) fit, remaining half tune and half test.

minimal_pilot.scope: Metadata-selected independent schema/learnability pilot. Full source groups kept together; no performance or power guarantee.
minimal_pilot.allocation: Within each source dataset and metadata split select SHA256-ranked eligible source groups: 2 fit, 1 tune, 1 test; eligibility is at least one GT track with >=6 manual anchors.
minimal_pilot.timeline: Only frames having at least one matched manual anchor are listed. This is a sparse TAO-anchor protocol, not dense continuous-frame evidence. Optional dense context collection requires a separate manifest.

training_use_policy.fit: Fit only targets with fit video split AND fit category; inference observations contain no GT filtering.
training_use_policy.tune: Tune only tune videos and fit categories. Category-holdout labels excluded from optimization and threshold selection.
training_use_policy.test: Readout video test and pseudo-novel category holdout opened only after method specification; no claim of statistical power.
training_use_policy.independence: Bootstrap/report by source group or video/trajectory clusters, never treat frame or pair counts as independent samples.
training_use_policy.residual_target: GT-free frozen inference first. Match only manual anchors in a separate supervised layer; unmatched observations unknown, not automatically negative.
training_use_policy.public_validation: Existing val cache and approved diagnostics remain external development evidence and are never training examples.

missing_before_executable_collection: An isolated inference copy and immutable collection config for the 1203 foreground vocabulary.
Self-describing dump schema, generalized cache builder, zero-observation frame receipts, and vocabulary parity smoke.
A sealed pilot annotation/config file preserving listed image/video/category IDs and track temporal order.
Class-blind GT matching and residual target construction with original/manual versus pseudo provenance.
A learnable mechanism and predeclared loss/control/readout evaluation; this metadata plan does not establish novelty or efficacy.
